description: Check whether a Swiss VAT number (MWST/TVA/IVA) is valid and active in the federal VAT register via the UID register, e.g. 'CHE-107.028.276 MWST', 'CHE107028276TVA' or '107028276'. Returns valid true/false, the normalised VAT number and (with include_details) the holder's name, address and VAT entry date; use it for supplier/invoice checks.

include_details.description: Also fetch the holder's name/address/VAT dates (one extra request)

name: validate_vat_number
title: Validate a Swiss VAT number
